title: Training Note — Reinvestment Waiver on Class H Preferred Stock Dividend Reversals, Member Equities & Patronage
content:
A Member Equities & Patronage Class H Preferred Stock holding with a reinvestment record has part of a dividend reversal waived.

## The rule

The reversal reinvestment waiver rests on the holding's reinvestment record: at least 8 reinvested dividend entries have 5 percent waived; at least 4 but fewer than 8 have 2 percent waived; fewer have none waived.

Waived percentages are summed into one percentage before it is applied: the reversal is charged at 100 less that sum, divided by 100, and rounded half up to the cent once, on the final figure.

## Questions answered

**What is counted?** Every reinvested dividend entry on the holding over its life, including the dividend being reversed.

**A holding with 7 entries?** 2 percent waived; 8 entries are needed for 5 percent.

**A holding with 3 entries?** None waived.

| Reinvested dividend entries | Waived |
|---|---|
| 8 or more | 5 percent |
| 4 to 7 | 2 percent |
| 0 to 3 | None |
